title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: 18. emphasises the EU’s decline in competitiveness, as highlighted in the Draghi report, and points out that the proliferation of standards places a burden on businesses, particularly SMEs, without guaranteeing better protection for workers; points out that Directive 89/391/EEC already covers psychosocial risks; calls on the Commission, accordingly, before taking any action, to carry out an impact assessment comprising an evaluation of the implementation of existing legislation, a competitiveness test and an SME test, and to consider a legislative proposal only when this assessment demonstrates the need for it;
